piece.caption:
How to prevent your customer AI chatbot from making legal or payment promises.

If you use an AI assistant for customer support or tenant queries, set hard limits on what it can promise. In a documented case, a landlord AI assistant told a tenant she could delay rent payment, leading to eviction disputes and legal liability. To avoid this in your shop or rental business, configure your bot only to answer general FAQs and route payment extension requests directly to a human.

Have you set strict guardrails on your WhatsApp or web customer bots?

Comment BOT for the full AI safety checklist.

piece.dm_text: Here is the AI Bot Safety Checklist for business owners: 1. Restrict AI permissions: Never allow chatbots to grant discounts, extend payment due dates, or alter payment terms. 2. Add human fallback: Route any billing or delay queries directly to a human team member. 3. Maintain chat logs: Keep record of customer interactions to prevent unauthorized commitments.
